Beware of fraudulent recruitment

It has come to our attention that individuals pretending to be Centrient employees sent out fake emails with job offers and appointment letters to job seekers. Please be informed that these emails are not sent on behalf of Centrient Pharmaceuticals (Centrient). Centrient follows a formal recruitment process through its HR department. It does not offer jobs via email. Please also be aware that Centrient will never request candidates in a recruitment process to deposit or pay any money to the company.

The recognized fake emails are sent from info@centrients.com or jobs@centrients.com, but other email addresses may also be in use. Centrient takes no responsibility for the content of these emails and subsequent actions and it will not accept any liability for any loss or damage that may be suffered or incurred directly or indirectly through correspondence with fraudulent individuals.

Should you come across any such fraudulent activity or have any information regarding solicitation for recruitment or employment with Centrient, please contact us at info@centrient.com.
